name: ESP32 touch box
description: An ESP32 board on the phone's USB port or Bluetooth becomes its touch screen, keyboard, mouse and gamepad, so the phone can be controlled without USB debugging. The extension finds the boards, shows them on the devices page, flashes their firmware, sets up their Wi-Fi and pairs them with this computer over Bluetooth.

touchMethods.name: esp32
touchMethods.title: ESP32
touchMethods.description: Touches, keys, the mouse and the gamepad go through the ESP32 touch box. Choose its serial port, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth in this phone's settings of the extension.

jobs.name: flash
jobs.title: Flash firmware
jobs.description: Writes the firmware that comes with the extension to a board: device is the board's id or its serial port, such as COM7.

jobs.name: wifi
jobs.title: Set up Wi-Fi
jobs.description: Sends a network name and password to a board on its serial port, with a key only this computer knows; an empty network name makes the board forget its Wi-Fi.

jobs.name: rename
jobs.title: Rename the board
jobs.description: Gives a board a new name of 1 to 32 bytes: its Bluetooth name, its name on the network and in GameScrcpy.

jobs.name: diagnose
jobs.title: Diagnose
jobs.description: Asks a board or a serial port what it is and says what is wrong: device is the board's id or a serial port such as COM7.

jobs.name: scan
jobs.title: Look for boards over Bluetooth
jobs.description: Listens for six seconds for ESP32 touch boxes nearby that a computer can reach over Bluetooth, and answers like the bluetooth node.

jobs.name: pair
jobs.title: Pair over Bluetooth
jobs.description: Pairs a board with this computer over Bluetooth: device is a board on this computer's USB, which gets its key first, or the Bluetooth address of a board found nearby, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

jobs.name: unpair
jobs.title: Forget the Bluetooth pairing
jobs.description: Removes a board's Bluetooth pairing from Windows and from this extension; the board keeps its key for Wi-Fi. device is the board's id or its Bluetooth address.

nodes.name: boards
nodes.description: The boards found now, each with its id, state, chip, firmware, phone and Wi-Fi.

nodes.name: ports
nodes.description: The serial ports of this computer, each with its name, title and kind.

nodes.name: firmware
nodes.description: The firmware that comes with the extension: its version and the chips it has images for.

nodes.name: language
nodes.description: The language of the texts the extension gives, zh_CN or en.

nodes.name: problem
nodes.description: Why the last search found no board, or empty text.

nodes.name: tap
nodes.description: Taps the middle of the phone's screen once through the board, to check that the phone side works.

nodes.name: disconnect
nodes.description: Lets go of a board until it is plugged in again or the boards are looked for again.

nodes.name: rescan
nodes.description: Looks for boards again, the ones let go of too.

nodes.name: bluetooth
nodes.description: This computer's Bluetooth state, the boards seen nearby lately with their address, signal and whether this computer has their key, and the boards paired over Bluetooth.

settings.title: ESP32 serial port
settings.description: The serial port of the ESP32 touch box, such as COM7. auto tries the Espressif, CH34x and CP210x ports one after another.
settings.keywords: esp32 serial port com usb touch box

settings.title: ESP32 connection
settings.description: Serial uses the board's USB serial port, with the least delay. Wi-Fi needs the board on the same network and adds 1 to 3 ms. Bluetooth needs the board paired with this computer first.
settings.keywords: esp32 wifi wireless serial udp bluetooth ble connection touch box

settings.title: ESP32 address
settings.description: The board's address on the network, or its Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF when the connection is Bluetooth. Empty finds it automatically.
settings.keywords: esp32 wifi bluetooth address ip mdns touch box

permissions.name: hardware
permissions.reason: Talks to the ESP32 boards over their serial ports and Bluetooth, and flashes their firmware.

permissions.name: devices.provide
permissions.reason: Shows the ESP32 boards on the devices page.

permissions.name: network
permissions.reason: Reaches boards over Wi-Fi on your local network.

zh_CN.name: ESP32 触控盒
zh_CN.description: 接在手机 USB 口或蓝牙上的 ESP32 开发板充当手机的触摸屏、键盘、鼠标和手柄，不开 USB 调试也能控制手机。扩展会找到开发板、把它们列在设备页、刷写固件、设置 Wi-Fi，并经蓝牙与这台电脑配对。
zh_CN.touchMethods.esp32.title: ESP32
zh_CN.touchMethods.esp32.description: 触控、按键、鼠标和手柄经 ESP32 触控盒发给手机。串口、Wi-Fi 或蓝牙在这台手机的扩展设置里选。
zh_CN.deviceProviders.boards.title: ESP32 触控盒
zh_CN.jobs.flash.title: 刷写固件
zh_CN.jobs.flash.description: 把扩展附带的固件写入开发板：device 是开发板的编号或它的串口，例如 COM7。
zh_CN.jobs.wifi.title: 设置 Wi-Fi
zh_CN.jobs.wifi.description: 把网络名称和密码经串口发给开发板，同时给一个只有这台电脑知道的密钥；网络名称留空则让开发板忘记 Wi-Fi。
zh_CN.jobs.rename.title: 重命名开发板
zh_CN.jobs.rename.description: 给开发板起一个 1～32 字节的新名称：它的蓝牙名称、网络上的名称和在 GameScrcpy 里的名称。
zh_CN.jobs.diagnose.title: 诊断
zh_CN.jobs.diagnose.description: 询问开发板或串口是什么，并说明哪里不对：device 是开发板的编号或串口，例如 COM7。
zh_CN.jobs.scan.title: 经蓝牙查找开发板
zh_CN.jobs.scan.description: 听六秒附近能让电脑经蓝牙连接的 ESP32 触控盒，回答的内容与 bluetooth 节点相同。
zh_CN.jobs.pair.title: 经蓝牙配对
zh_CN.jobs.pair.description: 让开发板经蓝牙与这台电脑配对：device 是接在这台电脑 USB 上的开发板（会先拿到密钥），或者附近找到的开发板的蓝牙地址，例如 AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF。
zh_CN.jobs.unpair.title: 忘记蓝牙配对
zh_CN.jobs.unpair.description: 从 Windows 和这个扩展里删除开发板的蓝牙配对；开发板的密钥留着给 Wi-Fi 用。device 是开发板的编号或蓝牙地址。
zh_CN.nodes.boards.description: 现在找到的开发板，每块带编号、状态、芯片、固件、手机与 Wi-Fi。
zh_CN.nodes.ports.description: 这台电脑的串口，每个带名字、标题与种类。
zh_CN.nodes.firmware.description: 扩展附带的固件：版本以及有镜像的芯片。
zh_CN.nodes.language.description: 扩展给出的文字的语言，zh_CN 或 en。
zh_CN.nodes.problem.description: 上一次查找为什么没有找到开发板，没有问题时为空。
zh_CN.nodes.tap.description: 经开发板在手机屏幕中央点一下，用来确认手机那头接好了。
zh_CN.nodes.disconnect.description: 放开一块开发板，直到它重新插上或者重新查找开发板。
zh_CN.nodes.rescan.description: 重新查找开发板，包括放开过的。
zh_CN.nodes.bluetooth.description: 这台电脑的蓝牙状态、最近在附近看到的开发板（地址、信号、这台电脑有没有它的密钥）以及经蓝牙配对过的开发板。
zh_CN.panels.main.title: ESP32 触控盒
zh_CN.panels.board.title: ESP32 设置
zh_CN.help.esp32.title: ESP32 触控盒
zh_CN.settings.port.title: ESP32 串口
zh_CN.settings.port.description: ESP32 触控盒的串口，例如 COM7。auto 会依次试乐鑫、CH34x、CP210x 的串口。
zh_CN.settings.port.keywords: esp32 串口 com usb 触控盒
zh_CN.settings.link.title: ESP32 连接方式
zh_CN.settings.link.description: 串口走开发板的 USB 串口，延迟最低。Wi-Fi 要开发板在同一个网络里，延迟多 1～3 毫秒。蓝牙要先让开发板与这台电脑配对。
zh_CN.settings.link.keywords: esp32 wifi 无线 串口 udp 蓝牙 ble 连接 触控盒
zh_CN.settings.address.title: ESP32 地址
zh_CN.settings.address.description: 开发板在网络上的地址；连接方式是蓝牙时填它的蓝牙地址，例如 AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF。留空则自动查找。
zh_CN.settings.address.keywords: esp32 wifi 蓝牙 地址 ip mdns 触控盒
